name: Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport
before:
New Orleans' airport, 11 miles west of downtown in Kenner, with nonstop flights to around sixty destinations including Europe, Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean.

The single most quotable fact about it: at an average of 4.5 feet above sea level, this is the third lowest lying international airport in the world, behind only Schiphol and Atyrau in Kazakhstan, both of which are actually below sea level.

The terminal is simple to explain to a client. Everything works on three levels: check in and departures on Level 3, security on Level 2, arrivals and baggage on Level 1. There are 35 gates across concourses A, B and C, and international arrivals clear customs in Concourse A.

Buses into the city are run by the New Orleans Regional Transit Authority on Airport Express route 202 and by Jefferson Parish Transit on the E-1, and the Airport Shuttle serves most hotels in the Central Business District.

The code MSY comes from the Moisant Stock Yards that once stood here.
after:
New Orleans' airport, 11 miles west of downtown in Kenner. The airport lists more than 50 nonstop destinations, among them London's Heathrow with British Airways, Toronto with Air Canada and, in season, Cancún.

It sits only a few feet above sea level.

The terminal is simple to explain to a client. Everything works on three levels: check-in on Level 3, security on Level 2 and baggage claim on Level 1. There are 35 gates across concourses A, B and C.

Buses into the city are run by the New Orleans Regional Transit Authority on Airport Express route 202 and by Jefferson Transit on the E1.

The code MSY comes from the Moisant Stock Yards, which once stood near the site.

claims.note: Was 'nonstop flights to around sixty destinations including Europe, Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean'. The airport's own list (read 23 Sep 2026) gives 'over 50 nonstop destinations', and its only international routes are London Heathrow (British Airways, five a week), Toronto (Air Canada, three a week) and Cancún (Breeze and Southwest, both marked seasonal); there is no Caribbean island or other Latin American destination. Given as the airport's own list. British Airways' own page (next claim) confirms its London flights.

claims.note: The agency's name is given as the airport writes it (Jefferson Transit, 'JET'), not 'Jefferson Parish Transit'; the route is the Veterans-Airport (E1), to City Park Avenue in New Orleans. Jefferson Transit's own site could not be read (503 to a plain request, 502 in the browser), so the E1 rests on the airport's live page and Wikipedia. RTA's 202 timetable is effective 20 September 2026. The airport says both buses leave from Level 1 baggage claim, outside Door 2.

claims.wasBefore: this is the third lowest lying international airport in the world, behind only Schiphol and Atyrau in Kazakhstan, both of which are actually below sea level
